verdict.rationale: Offloading to a hosted cloud tier is a fair question for a local inference runtime, but the evidence shows no LocalAI-hosted cloud tier for running large models without downloading them. The closest items are self-managed distributed GPU worker nodes and the option to point --external-grpc-backends at a remote URL. Both are building blocks the user would have to host themselves, not a hosted offload tier.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
